Container.Name: pricecious
Container.Overview:
Pricecious is a self-hosted, AI-powered price tracker. It opens each product page in a headless browser (Browserless), takes a screenshot and asks a vision model (Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or OpenRouter) for the price and stock status, so it keeps working on pages where CSS selectors break.
**Features**
- Price and stock history with a screenshot of every check - Lowest-price and sale badges, target prices and a "Deals" filter - Tag-based compare charts and optional Prophet price forecasts - Bookmarklet to add the product page you are looking at - Notifications through Apprise (Discord, Telegram, ntfy, email, Pushover and many more) when prices drop, hit your target or items come back in stock
**Before you install**
1. A PostgreSQL database (any recent version, e.g. the official postgres container). Create an empty database such as `pricewatch`. 2. A Browserless container, e.g. `ghcr.io/browserless/chromium` (or the older `browserless/chrome`), reachable from this container on port 3000. 3. A vision model: a local Ollama model, or an API key for a hosted provider.
**Setup**
1. Fill in the Database URL and Browserless URL below and start the container. Database migrations run automatically on start. 2. Open the WebUI, go to **Settings** and pick your AI provider, model and API key. AI, scraper, schedule and notification settings live in the Settings page, not in environment variables. 3. Add products on the **Items** page.
**Security:** Pricecious has no user authentication. Anyone who can reach it can change settings and trigger AI-backed checks. Keep it on your LAN or VPN, or put it behind a reverse proxy with authentication, and never port-forward it to the internet. Ideally run Browserless behind an egress firewall that blocks private addresses.
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL database Browserless (headless Chrome) container A vision model: local Ollama, or an API key for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or OpenRouter

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Pricecious web interface and API.

Config.Name: Screenshots
Config.Description: Screenshot history for every price check.

Config.Name: Browserless URL
Config.Description: Required. WebSocket URL of your Browserless container, or of any Chrome with remote debugging enabled. Replace the example IP with your server's IP.

Config.Name: Browserless Token
Config.Description: The TOKEN set on your Browserless container, if any.

Config.Name: Browserless Stealth Mode
Config.Description: Ask Browserless to use stealth mode, which helps on sites that block headless browsers.

Config.Name: Browserless Block Ads
Config.Description: Ask Browserless to block ads while loading pages.

Config.Name: Browserless Headless Mode
Config.Description: Headless mode passed to Browserless, e.g. new, true or false. Leave empty for the Browserless default.

Config.Name: Viewport Width
Config.Description: Browser viewport width in pixels, e.g. 1920. Leave empty for the default.

Config.Name: Viewport Height
Config.Description: Browser viewport height in pixels, e.g. 1080. Leave empty for the default.

Config.Name: CORS Origins
Config.Description: Extra trusted browser origins, comma separated, e.g. https://pricecious.example.com. Same-origin requests need no entry.
